newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela, Brasil to sign oil pact by June - Giusti.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela, Brasil to sign oil pact by June - Giusti.

text.p: Venezuela and Brazil will sign a bilateral oil agreement by the end of June, Petroleos de Venezuela (PDVSA) chief Luis Giusti said Thursday.
PDVSA and its Brazilian counterpart Petrobras have been talking about a wide-ranging oil agreement for the past few months, but Giusti said the details have yet to be defined.

"We have been talking about projects where they (Petrobras) could participate in some oilfields here in Venezuela and we could participate in the Brazilian internal market," he told reporters in the presidential Miraflores palace.
They have not decided which fields Petrobras would work in, but that the contract would be similar to existing operating agreements that Venezuela has signed with other companies, he added.
"We established the basic concept in meetings with the Brazilians, and we will have a final agreement by the end of June," Giusti said.
